newsitem.title: GREECE: Italy's Concretum buys 12pct Heracles Cement stake.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Concretum buys 12pct Heracles Cement stake.

text.p: Italy's Concretum signed an agreement with state National Bank, effectively acquiring a 12 percent stake in Heracles Cements for 32.2 billion drachmas, or 5,320 drachmas a share.

Concretum exercised its option based on a December 23 1991 agreement and acquired 50 percent of National Bank's shares in CalNat which corresponds to a 12 percent stake in Aget Heracles, National Bank said.
Calnat, a joint venture between National Bank and Italy's Calcestruzzi, owns 50.5 percent of Heracles Cements. Concretum exercises management of Heracles through Calnat.
"The price for the share transfer was agreed at 32.23 billion drachmas, or 5,320 drachmas a share," National Bank, Greece's largest state commercial bank said.
Shares of Heracles were trading up 195 drachmas at 3,190 mid-session on Friday.
